polityNote: Republic of Burundi. First level = provinces (and Bujumbura Mairie from 1991). Atoms are the 119 communes of geoBoundaries BDI ADM2 (2007 vintage with the three 2014 communes of Bujumbura Mairie; NYU Spatial Data Repository / Stanford / Map Maker, public domain). Provinces are unions of communes; after 1982 the change list moves only whole communes (1991 Bujumbura split, 1998 Mwaro, 2015 Rumonge). The 2025 reform into five provinces is after the scope.

The eight provinces are unions of the 1982 provinces except where 1982 moved communes across them: Gitanga and Bukemba (Bururi → Rutana) are known, but Bukirasazi arrondissement was absorbed «almost all» into Gitega and the destination of the rest is not stated, and Mwisare's transfer to Bujumbura is dated only ~1969.
